ModMetaData.name: Better Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Better Work Tab v1.1 adds drag-and-drop ordering, skill overlays, automation rules, extended priorities up to 99, workloads, dividers, and visual customization to RimWorld's Work tab.
You can toggle features in settings.
Version support: - 0.19 -> v1.1 - Multiplayer does not work
Support: Discord: https://discord.gg/QYBBaRkKWs
